## Obsidian

Install Obsidian from Flathub with the dedicated `obsidian` role.

```sh
ansible-playbook -i inventory -K playbooks/lab-stack.yml --tags obsidian
```

::: {.callout-check}
**✅ Check**

```sh
flatpak info md.obsidian.Obsidian
```
:::
